title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a/ KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval for a 365-day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Wellesley College.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deiredre K. Manning. (GC 02-04)
